label: late inbound
comment: i wouldnt tell the office i am free at this stage as we are still at the first stage of a whole turnaround, being only 3 minutes time could be recovered somewhere else, if longer i would agree its not recoverable,  but as it is short i would. consider to try to make the time else where, so there is recoverable actions not mentioned

label: steps not powering (GSE)
comment: there is a rcoverable action, its a problem out of our control, but an example of action is to coordinate with the team leader, the ramp allocator, our office to get other steps sent to the stand in a timley manner, and as the delay happens at the beginning of the arrival, depending on the quickness of the response, the lenght of the delay could be cut and, time could be made up fore else where
